writer.name: 莱蒂希娅·赖特 Letitia Wright

director.name: 莱蒂希娅·赖特 Letitia Wright

introduction: The coming-of-age fantasy drama follows the experiences of young Black men whose lives have been abruptly snatched away. Sandy is Micah, a young man who finds himself in the Inbetween, a mysterious realm between life and death, after his life is suddenly cut short. As he journeys through this liminal space, guided by a group of other young men, they confront what it means to be a Black boy in today’s society, weaving together a narrative of resilience and self-discovery, in order to ultimately empower each other to embrace empathy, mutual compassion and self-worth.
